rows.label: tlk70000057_03_msg0001
rows.name:
I don't remember much about when we
escaped from our village.

rows.label: tlk70000057_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Mom told us to run, and my older
brother took my hand...

rows.label: tlk70000057_03_msg0003
rows.name:
But it's okay. My older brother told
me Mom escaped somewhere else.

rows.label: tlk70000057_03_msg0004
rows.name:
So we decided to go get Mom together
with Dad.

rows.label: tlk70000057_03_msg0005
rows.name:
I want to see her soon.
I want to eat Mom's cooking.
